speaker: narrator
text: Touch the map beside a town and raise your factory.

speaker: narrator
text: The factory is the hub. Every road and rail comes home to it.

speaker: narrator
text: Now a depot. Set it beside a mill, a mine, or a forest.

speaker: narrator
text: No depot yet. Open Depot, then mark the ground by an industry.

speaker: narrator
text: Match three gems. Your score sets how much this depot yields.

speaker: narrator
text: Clear what you can. A high score pays on every tick.

speaker: narrator
text: Pick Dirt Road. Drag from the depot back to your factory.

speaker: narrator
text: Nothing ticks until the road joins depot and factory.

speaker: narrator
text: You are producing. Stars come from depots, roads, and the city.

speaker: narrator
text: When the purse allows, raise the city. Every depot ticks faster.

speaker: narrator
text: Hear that? The first cargo has ticked into the purse.

speaker: narrator
text: Keep the road open. Every tick is wages on the ledger.

speaker: narrator
text: Rail hauls faster than a road. Lay track from industry to plant.

speaker: narrator
text: Keep the run straight. A train will not take a sharp corner.

speaker: narrator
text: Raise a platform at each end. That is where the train stops.

speaker: narrator
text: One platform at the industry, one at the factory. Then she runs.

speaker: rival
text: That mill is mine. You studied the map too long.

speaker: rival
text: First depot on the site keeps it. Read your own charter.

speaker: rival
text: Claimed. Complain to the wind, if the wind is hiring.

speaker: rival
text: You took my industry? Bold, for a firm still hiring clerks.

speaker: rival
text: Enjoy the ore. I shall enjoy sending the invoice.

speaker: rival
text: Road's shut. My men are very thorough about standing still.

speaker: rival
text: A blockade, not a suggestion. Your lorries can wait in line.

speaker: rival
text: Forty-five seconds. I have had naps longer than your schedule.

speaker: rival
text: The board is mine. Do try to lose with more dignity.

speaker: rival
text: Match lost. Your gems were decorative. Mine were loaded.

speaker: rival
text: A fluke. The next board will not be so kind.

speaker: rival
text: You won a skirmish. I still own the timetable.

speaker: rival
text: I am ahead on the stars. Do keep up, if you can.

speaker: rival
text: The ledger prefers me today. It usually does.

speaker: rival
text: Pulling ahead. Your factory looks rather lonely from up here.

speaker: rival
text: A lucky season. Do not expect the next one to be.

speaker: rival
text: The stars are mine. Your lorries may go home now.

speaker: player
text: First depot is up. Without a road it is only a shed.

speaker: player
text: Depot placed. The industry answers to us, if the road holds.

speaker: player
text: There she goes. First train on the line, and on time.

speaker: player
text: Whistle's up. The yard finally sounds like a proper railway.

speaker: player
text: The island is ours. File the ledger, and light the lamps.

speaker: player
text: We crossed the line. Tell the rival to mind the gate.

speaker: player
text: They took the prize. The yard still stands. We rebuild.

speaker: player
text: Beaten on the stars. Not on the will to lay more track.

speaker: player
text: Board is ours. Their industry can wait on our timetable.

speaker: player
text: Lost the match. The road is still mine to pave.
